title: Record patterns as switch cases

blocks.text: Record patterns are also `case` labels, so one switch expression can take apart several record types. `case null` gives the `null` selector its own answer.

`Shapes` holds `Point(int x, int y)`, `Rectangle(Point topLeft, Point bottomRight)` and `Circle(Point center, int radius)`. Write `describe(Object shape)` in `Shapes` as one switch expression, following the course's own `describeShape`:

cases.says: A rectangle is described by its two corners.
A circle is described by its centre and radius.
describe(null) is "Null shape", not a NullPointerException.

concepts: Record patterns work as case labels of a switch, with case null for a null selector.
